stem.en: During electroconvulsive therapy, continuous EEG and assisted ventilation are already in place. Generalized motor activity and EEG seizure activity continue to 120 seconds. The ECT clinician identifies a prolonged seizure and gives protocol-directed orders. Place the nursing and team actions in the correct sequence.
stem.zh: 电休克治疗期间已持续进行脑电监测和辅助通气。全身运动活动和脑电癫痫活动持续到 120 秒。电休克治疗临床医生判断为延长癫痫发作并下达方案规定的医嘱。请按正确顺序排列护理和团队措施。

correct.en: A seizure still present at 120 seconds should be actively terminated rather than observed longer. The prescribed short-acting anticonvulsant anesthetic or benzodiazepine is administered while airway support and EEG monitoring continue. The team confirms EEG—not only motor—termination, then continues respiratory, neurologic, and hemodynamic recovery monitoring. Before another treatment, the team reviews modifiable risk factors and the anesthetic/ECT plan.
correct.zh: 癫痫活动持续到 120 秒时应主动终止，而不是继续等待。按医嘱给予短效抗惊厥麻醉药或苯二氮䓬类药物，同时继续气道支持和脑电监测。团队需确认脑电活动而不仅是运动活动已经终止，随后继续监测呼吸、神经和血流动力学恢复。下一次治疗前，应评估可改变的危险因素并调整麻醉/电休克治疗计划。

byChoice.en: First: at the 120-second threshold, the prolonged seizure requires protocol-directed pharmacologic termination.
byChoice.zh: 第一：达到 120 秒阈值时，应按方案用药终止延长癫痫发作。

byChoice.en: Second: ventilation, oxygenation, and EEG must continue while the terminating medication acts.
byChoice.zh: 第二：终止发作药物起效期间必须继续通气、氧合和脑电监测。

byChoice.en: Third: motor quieting is not enough; EEG termination must be confirmed because nonconvulsive activity can persist.
byChoice.zh: 第三：仅运动停止并不足够；非惊厥性活动可能持续，因此必须确认脑电终止。

byChoice.en: Fourth: after electrical termination, monitor until respiratory function, consciousness, and hemodynamics recover.
byChoice.zh: 第四：脑电发作终止后，继续监测直至呼吸功能、意识和血流动力学恢复。

byChoice.en: Last: recurrence prevention and treatment-plan revision occur after the immediate episode is controlled.
byChoice.zh: 最后：控制当前事件后，再进行复发预防和治疗方案调整。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use the time threshold first, then follow the dependency chain: terminate, verify electrical termination, recover, and prevent recurrence.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先应用时间阈值，再按依赖顺序处理：终止发作、确认脑电终止、完成恢复监测、预防再次发生。

glossary.defZh: 电休克治疗后癫痫活动持续超过需要主动终止的时间阈值
脑电图显示的持续发作活动，可能比可见运动持续更久
用于快速诱导全身麻醉的短效药物

meta.source: National Library of Medicine, Electroconvulsive Therapy (StatPearls), sections “Personnel,” “Preparation,” and discussion of prolonged seizures in “Technique”; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK538266/; and Aloysi et al., “Management of Prolonged Seizures During Electroconvulsive Therapy,” paragraphs 2–4; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4031601/; accessed 2026-07-27.

options.en: Administer the protocol-directed seizure-terminating medication at the clinician's order.
options.zh: 按临床医生医嘱给予方案规定的终止癫痫发作药物。

options.en: Continue assisted ventilation, oxygenation, and continuous EEG while the medication takes effect.
options.zh: 药物起效期间继续辅助通气、氧合和持续脑电监测。

options.en: Confirm that EEG seizure activity has ended, even if motor activity stopped earlier.
options.zh: 确认脑电癫痫活动已终止，即使运动活动更早停止。

options.en: Continue post-anesthesia respiratory, neurologic, and hemodynamic monitoring until recovery criteria are met.
options.zh: 继续麻醉后呼吸、神经和血流动力学监测，直至达到恢复标准。

options.en: Before the next ECT session, review medications and treatment factors that may prolong seizures and revise the plan.
options.zh: 下一次电休克治疗前，复核可能延长癫痫发作的药物和治疗因素，并修订方案。

stem.en: A client at 40 weeks is receiving oxytocin. The tracing shows 6 contractions in 10 minutes, recurrent late decelerations, and minimal variability. Maternal blood pressure is 86/50 mm Hg after an epidural top-up; oxygen saturation is 98% on room air. The unit protocol uses the conditional sequence represented by the actions below. Place the actions in order.
stem.zh: 一名孕 40 周的患者正在接受缩宫素。监护显示 10 分钟 6 次宫缩、反复晚期减速和最小变异。硬膜外追加药物后母体血压为 86/50 mmHg，室内空气下血氧饱和度 98%。本单位方案采用下列措施所表示的条件性顺序。请按顺序排列。

correct.en: First remove the iatrogenic uterine stimulus and obtain urgent obstetric review. Next correct the documented maternal perfusion problem with lateral positioning and IV fluid according to the protocol while continuous monitoring continues. If excessive contractions persist, give the prescribed tocolytic. If late decelerations and minimal variability do not resolve after these measures, proceed with preparation for expedited birth. Routine maternal oxygen is not indicated because the client is not hypoxic.
correct.zh: 首先去除医源性宫缩刺激并立即获得产科紧急评估。随后在持续监护下，采用侧卧位并按方案静脉补液，纠正已记录的母体灌注问题。若宫缩过频持续，按医嘱给予宫缩抑制药。若采取这些措施后晚期减速和最小变异仍未改善，则准备加速分娩。患者没有缺氧，因此不应常规给予母体氧气。

byChoice.en: First: stop the medication driving excessive contractions and activate urgent review for the red fetal-heart-rate features.
byChoice.zh: 第一：停止导致宫缩过频的药物，并因红色胎心特征启动紧急评估。

byChoice.en: Second: the documented hypotension after an epidural top-up requires lateral positioning and IV fluid correction.
byChoice.zh: 第二：硬膜外追加药物后的明确低血压需要侧卧位和静脉补液纠正。

byChoice.en: Third: tocolysis is conditional on excessive contractions persisting after oxytocin is stopped and perfusion is addressed.
byChoice.zh: 第三：停止缩宫素并处理灌注后若宫缩过频仍持续，才条件性给予宫缩抑制药。

byChoice.en: Last: persistent late decelerations and minimal variability despite corrective measures require preparation for expedited birth.
byChoice.zh: 最后：纠正措施后晚期减速和最小变异仍持续时，需要准备加速分娩。

testTakingStrategy.en: Order the steps by cause removal, maternal perfusion correction, conditional tocolysis, and escalation if the tracing remains abnormal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 按“去除病因、纠正母体灌注、条件性抑制宫缩、若监护仍异常则升级处理”的顺序排列。

glossary.defZh: 10 分钟内宫缩达到或超过 5 次并减少宫缩间休息时间
用于降低子宫收缩频率或强度的药物
因母胎风险而尽快完成分娩的处理

meta.source: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence, NG229 “Fetal monitoring in labour,” recommendations 1.4.11–1.4.14, 1.4.20–1.4.26, and 1.5.11–1.5.13; https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations; accessed 2026-07-27.

options.en: Stop the oxytocin infusion and obtain urgent obstetric review while continuous monitoring continues.
options.zh: 停止缩宫素输注，在持续监护的同时获得紧急产科评估。

options.en: Move the client to a left lateral position and begin the prescribed IV fluid for epidural-associated hypotension.
options.zh: 将患者置于左侧卧位，并按医嘱为硬膜外相关低血压开始静脉补液。

options.en: If excessive contractions persist, administer the prescribed tocolytic.
options.zh: 若宫缩过频持续，按医嘱给予宫缩抑制药。

options.en: If the fetal heart rate abnormalities persist after conservative measures, prepare for expedited birth.
options.zh: 若保守措施后胎心异常持续，准备加速分娩。

stem.en: Twenty minutes after a platelet transfusion begins, a client develops shaking rigors, temperature 39.4°C (102.9°F), blood pressure 78/42 mm Hg, and vomiting. The client had no fever before transfusion. The nurse suspects bacterial contamination with transfusion-associated sepsis. Place the actions in the correct sequence.
stem.zh: 血小板输注开始 20 分钟后，患者出现寒战、体温 39.4°C（102.9°F）、血压 78/42 mmHg 和呕吐。输注前患者无发热。护士怀疑血液成分细菌污染并导致输血相关脓毒症。请按正确顺序排列措施。

correct.en: The transfusion is stopped immediately and the implicated component is preserved; IV access is maintained with new tubing and compatible fluid. The nurse then activates the provider/transfusion-service response and supports airway and circulation. Patient blood cultures and culture of the residual component are obtained promptly. Prescribed sepsis antimicrobials and hemodynamic support follow without avoidable delay, and the investigation is completed with ongoing monitoring and documentation.
correct.zh: 应立即停止输血并保留涉事血液成分；使用新管路和相容液体维持静脉通路。随后启动医生和输血服务响应，并支持气道与循环。尽快采集患者血培养并培养剩余血液成分。之后在避免不必要延误的前提下按医嘱给予脓毒症抗菌药物和血流动力学支持，并通过持续监测和记录完成调查。

byChoice.en: First: immediately end exposure, preserve the implicated unit for testing, and keep usable IV access through new tubing.
byChoice.zh: 第一：立即停止暴露，保留涉事血液成分用于检测，并通过新管路维持可用静脉通路。

byChoice.en: Second: profound hypotension and rigors require immediate clinical and transfusion-service activation with ABC support.
byChoice.zh: 第二：严重低血压和寒战要求立即启动临床及输血服务响应并支持 ABC。

byChoice.en: Third: paired patient and residual-component cultures are central to confirming and investigating contamination.
byChoice.zh: 第三：患者血培养和剩余血液成分培养是确认和调查污染的核心。

byChoice.en: Fourth: after rapid cultures are obtained, prescribed sepsis treatment should not be delayed.
byChoice.zh: 第四：迅速取得培养后，不应延误按医嘱实施脓毒症治疗。

byChoice.en: Last: ongoing monitoring, documentation, and communication complete the reaction investigation after immediate stabilization steps.
byChoice.zh: 最后：完成即时稳定措施后，以持续监测、记录和沟通完成输血反应调查。

testTakingStrategy.en: The source is the transfusion: stop exposure first, preserve evidence, obtain paired cultures, then treat sepsis and complete the investigation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 污染源是正在输注的血液成分：先停止暴露并保留证据，再取得配对培养，随后治疗脓毒症并完成调查。

glossary.defZh: 血液成分中存在可导致受血者感染的细菌
停止输注后血袋中保留、可用于检测的剩余制品
伴随剧烈发抖的寒冷感，常见于严重发热或菌血症

meta.source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, “Clinical Guidance for Bacterial Contamination and Blood Safety,” sections “Recommendations” and “A blood or blood component recipient has signs or symptoms consistent with post-transfusion bacteremia”; https://www.cdc.gov/blood-safety/hcp/clinical-guidance/index.html; and Society of Critical Care Medicine, Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026, recommendations under “Blood culture” and “Antibiotic initiation”; https://www.sccm.org/clinical-resources/guidelines/guidelines/surviving-sepsis-campaign-international-guidelines-for-management-of-sepsis-and-septic-shock-2026; accessed 2026-07-27.

options.en: Stop the transfusion immediately, disconnect and save the component and original tubing, and maintain IV access with new tubing and compatible fluid.
options.zh: 立即停止输血，断开并保留血液成分及原管路，使用新管路和相容液体维持静脉通路。

options.en: Activate the provider and transfusion-service response; assess and support airway, breathing, and circulation.
options.zh: 启动医生和输血服务响应；评估并支持气道、呼吸和循环。

options.en: Obtain ordered patient blood cultures and send the residual component and tubing for culture according to protocol.
options.zh: 按方案采集医嘱要求的患者血培养，并将剩余血液成分和管路送培养。

options.en: Administer prescribed broad-spectrum antimicrobials and sepsis-directed hemodynamic support without avoidable delay.
options.zh: 在避免不必要延误的前提下，按医嘱给予广谱抗菌药物和脓毒症血流动力学支持。

options.en: Continue close vital-sign and urine-output monitoring, document the reaction, and ensure results are communicated to the transfusion service.
options.zh: 继续密切监测生命体征和尿量，记录反应，并确保结果传达给输血服务。

stem.en:
Interpret each record independently. Choose the most appropriate immediate renal-replacement-therapy disposition for each client; do not use one record to answer another.

Record A: AKI with potassium 6.8 mEq/L and widening QRS persists after calcium, insulin with dextrose, and a potassium-removal protocol.
Record B: AKI with diffuse crackles, frothy sputum, and oxygen saturation 84% persists after prescribed IV loop diuretic and ventilatory support.
Record C: AKI with BUN 96 mg/dL and creatinine 5.6 mg/dL; potassium is 4.3 mEq/L, bicarbonate 23 mEq/L, lungs are clear, mentation is baseline, and urine output is improving after treatment of obstruction.
stem.zh:
请分别独立解读每份记录。为每名患者选择最合适的即时肾脏替代治疗处置；不要用一份记录的信息回答另一份记录。

记录 A：急性肾损伤，血钾 6.8 mEq/L 且 QRS 增宽；在给予钙剂、胰岛素加葡萄糖及降钾方案后仍持续。
记录 B：急性肾损伤，弥漫性湿啰音、泡沫痰、血氧饱和度 84%；在按医嘱静脉袢利尿剂和通气支持后仍持续。
记录 C：急性肾损伤，BUN 96 mg/dL、肌酐 5.6 mg/dL；血钾 4.3 mEq/L、碳酸氢根 23 mEq/L，双肺清，意识为基线，解除梗阻后尿量正在改善。

correct.en: Record A has hyperkalemia with ECG changes that persists despite medical treatment, so immediate specialist discussion and RRT referral are indicated. Record B has pulmonary edema with hypoxemia that persists despite medical management, also an immediate RRT indication. Record C has severe laboratory abnormalities but no refractory complication; the decision is based on the whole clinical condition, not an isolated urea or creatinine value.
correct.zh: 记录 A 为经药物治疗后仍持续且伴心电图改变的高钾血症，应立即与专科讨论并转诊肾脏替代治疗。记录 B 为经药物处理后仍持续的肺水肿和低氧血症，同样属于即时肾脏替代治疗指征。记录 C 虽实验室数值严重异常，但无难治性并发症；是否开始治疗应依据整体临床状况，而不是孤立的尿素或肌酐数值。

byChoice.en: Record A: refractory hyperkalemia with ECG changes is an immediate RRT-referral indication.
byChoice.zh: 记录 A：伴心电图改变且难治的高钾血症属于立即转诊肾脏替代治疗的指征。

byChoice.en: Record B: pulmonary edema and hypoxemia persisting despite medical management require immediate RRT referral.
byChoice.zh: 记录 B：经药物治疗后仍持续的肺水肿和低氧血症需要立即转诊肾脏替代治疗。

byChoice.en: Record C: improving urine output and absence of refractory electrolyte, acid-base, uremic, or volume complications support continued reassessment rather than RRT based on BUN/creatinine alone.
byChoice.zh: 记录 C：尿量改善且无难治性电解质、酸碱、尿毒症或容量并发症，因此应继续复评，而不是仅凭 BUN/肌酐开始肾脏替代治疗。

testTakingStrategy.en: For RRT, search each record for a complication that is not responding to medical management; do not dialyze a number alone.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断肾脏替代治疗时，应在每份记录中寻找对药物治疗无反应的并发症；不要只因某个数值而透析。

glossary.defZh: 通过透析或相关技术替代部分肾脏清除和液体调节功能
经过适当治疗后仍未改善
肾功能严重下降导致代谢废物蓄积并出现症状或并发症

meta.source: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence, NG148 “Acute kidney injury: prevention, detection and management,” recommendations 1.5.6–1.5.10; https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng148/chapter/Recommendations; accessed 2026-07-27.

stem.en:
For each independent workplace record, select the best first assertive response. Each response should be clear, respectful, specific, and should propose a safe next step.

Record A: A provider says, “Give the cefazolin anyway,” after the nurse points to a documented cefazolin anaphylaxis.
Record B: A coworker repeatedly interrupts a high-risk postoperative handoff with unrelated questions.
Record C: The charge nurse assigns a second unstable client to a nurse who is actively titrating a vasoactive infusion and has no coverage.
stem.zh:
针对每份独立的工作场景记录，选择最佳的首次坚定沟通回应。回应应清晰、尊重、具体，并提出安全的下一步。

记录 A：护士指出病历中记录有头孢唑林过敏性休克后，医生仍说：“还是给头孢唑林。”
记录 B：一名同事反复用无关问题打断高风险术后交接。
记录 C：一名护士正在滴定血管活性药物且无人替班，责任护士又给其分配第二名病情不稳定的患者。

correct.en: An effective first assertion states the concrete concern and problem, remains respectful, and offers an actionable solution. Record A explicitly connects the allergy evidence to the unsafe order and requests an alternative. Record B sets a time-limited boundary that protects a critical handoff. Record C names the unsafe workload and asks for coverage or reassignment. Passive compliance, personal attacks, and vague escalation are weaker first responses.
correct.zh: 有效的首次坚定沟通应说明具体担忧和问题，保持尊重，并提出可执行的解决方案。记录 A 把过敏证据与不安全医嘱明确联系起来并要求替代方案；记录 B 设置有时间限制的边界以保护关键交接；记录 C 指出不安全工作量并请求支援或重新分配。被动服从、人身攻击或含糊升级都不是最佳首次回应。

byChoice.en: Record A: the keyed statement pauses an unsafe action, cites the exact evidence, and requests a specific alternative.
byChoice.zh: 记录 A：正确陈述暂停不安全行为，引用确切证据，并要求具体替代方案。

byChoice.en: Record B: the keyed statement protects the handoff with a clear, time-limited boundary and preserves later communication.
byChoice.zh: 记录 B：正确陈述以清晰、限时的边界保护交接，同时保留稍后沟通。

byChoice.en: Record C: the keyed statement names the immediate workload hazard and offers two concrete staffing solutions.
byChoice.zh: 记录 C：正确陈述指出即时工作量风险，并提出两种具体人员配置解决方案。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose the response that names the observable risk and asks for a concrete correction without attacking the person.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择能够指出可观察风险并要求具体纠正、同时不攻击对方人格的回应。

glossary.defZh: 以清晰、尊重且不威胁的方式提出担忧和解决方案
团队成员为防止过载和错误而提供具体工作支持
传递会直接影响患者安全的重要临床信息

meta.source: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality, TeamSTEPPS 3.0, “Tool: Advocacy and Assertion,” section “Effective assertive statements” and five-step process; https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/mutual/tools/advocacy.html; and “Section 2: Explanation of Mutual Support Key Concepts and Tools,” subsection “Mutual Support”; https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/mutual/tools/index.html; accessed 2026-07-27.

options.en: “I need to pause this order. The chart documents cefazolin anaphylaxis. Please select a non-cefazolin alternative before administration.”
options.zh: “我需要暂停执行这项医嘱。病历记录患者曾对头孢唑林发生过敏性休克。请在给药前选择非头孢唑林替代药物。”

options.en: “Fine, but you will be responsible if the client reacts.”
options.zh: “好吧，但如果患者出现反应，责任由你承担。”

options.en: Administer the medication silently because the provider repeated the order.
options.zh: 因医生重复了医嘱而默默给药。

options.en: “I need two uninterrupted minutes to finish the critical handoff; then I will answer your questions.”
options.zh: “我需要两分钟不被打断来完成关键交接，之后我会回答你的问题。”

options.en: “You are always rude and never let anyone work.”
options.zh: “你总是很无礼，从来不让别人工作。”

options.en: Stop the handoff and leave without arranging completion.
options.zh: 停止交接并离开，也不安排完成交接。

options.en: “I cannot safely accept another unstable client while titrating this infusion without coverage. Please provide immediate relief or reassign the client.”
options.zh: “在无人替班且我正在滴定此输注时，我无法安全接收另一名不稳定患者。请立即安排支援或重新分配该患者。”

options.en: Accept the assignment and plan to complete both assessments later.
options.zh: 接受分配，计划稍后再完成两名患者的评估。

options.en: Say, “This unit is impossible,” and walk away from the charge nurse.
options.zh: 说“这个科室根本没法干”，然后转身离开责任护士。

stem.en:
Interpret each reproductive-health record independently and choose the safest next disposition or instruction.

Record A: At about 7 weeks by dates, a client with a positive pregnancy test develops sudden severe left pelvic pain, shoulder pain, weakness, and dizziness.
Record B: A client at 31 weeks reports new bright-red vaginal bleeding that has soaked a pad; there is no scheduled visit today.
Record C: A client took ulipristal acetate for emergency contraception today and asks when to restart a combined hormonal pill.
stem.zh:
请分别独立解读每份生殖健康记录，并选择最安全的下一步处置或指导。

记录 A：按日期约孕 7 周，妊娠试验阳性的患者突然出现剧烈左侧盆腔痛、肩痛、虚弱和头晕。
记录 B：一名孕 31 周患者报告新发鲜红色阴道出血，已浸透一片卫生巾；今天没有预约就诊。
记录 C：一名患者今天服用了醋酸乌利司他进行紧急避孕，并询问何时重新开始复方激素避孕药。

correct.en: Record A has emergency symptoms of possible ruptured ectopic pregnancy and requires emergency-department care. Record B has third-trimester bleeding and should go to the hospital now rather than await a routine visit. Record C concerns ulipristal acetate: hormonal contraception should begin no sooner than 5 days afterward, followed by 7 days of abstinence or barrier protection after restarting.
correct.zh: 记录 A 出现可能异位妊娠破裂的急症表现，需要立即到急诊。记录 B 为妊娠晚期出血，应立即到医院而不是等待常规就诊。记录 C 涉及醋酸乌利司他：激素避孕应至少等待 5 天后再开始，重启后还需禁欲或使用屏障避孕 7 天。

byChoice.en: Record A: sudden severe unilateral pain with shoulder pain, weakness, and dizziness is an emergency pattern for possible tubal rupture.
byChoice.zh: 记录 A：突发剧烈单侧疼痛伴肩痛、虚弱和头晕，是可能输卵管破裂的急症模式。

byChoice.en: Record B: any late-pregnancy bleeding warrants immediate obstetric contact or hospital evaluation; soaking a pad increases urgency.
byChoice.zh: 记录 B：任何孕晚期出血都需要立即联系产科或到医院评估；浸透卫生巾进一步增加紧急程度。

byChoice.en: Record C: starting progestin-containing contraception too soon may reduce ulipristal effectiveness; wait at least 5 days and then use backup for 7 days.
byChoice.zh: 记录 C：过早开始含孕激素避孕可能降低醋酸乌利司他效果；应至少等待 5 天，并在重启后备用避孕 7 天。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not blend the records: identify the time-sensitive hazard or medication-specific rule inside each one.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要混合各记录的信息：分别识别每份记录中的时间敏感危险或药物特异性规则。

glossary.defZh: 受精卵在子宫腔外着床并生长的妊娠
妊娠晚期出现的阴道流血，可能提示严重母胎问题
一种选择性孕激素受体调节剂，可用于紧急避孕

meta.source: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, “Ectopic Pregnancy,” FAQ section on emergency symptoms; https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/ectopic-pregnancy; ACOG, “Bleeding During Pregnancy,” FAQ section on bleeding later in pregnancy; https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/bleeding-during-pregnancy; and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, U.S. Selected Practice Recommendations, “Emergency Contraception,” section “Use of regular contraception after ECPs — Ulipristal Acetate”; https://www.cdc.gov/contraception/hcp/usspr/emergency-contraception.html; accessed 2026-07-27.

options.en: Go to the emergency department now for possible ruptured ectopic pregnancy.
options.zh: 因可能异位妊娠破裂，立即前往急诊。

options.en: Schedule a routine prenatal visit within 1 week.
options.zh: 安排 1 周内常规产前就诊。

options.en: Rest at home and repeat a urine pregnancy test tomorrow.
options.zh: 在家休息，明天重复尿妊娠试验。

options.en: Go to the hospital now for evaluation of late-pregnancy bleeding.
options.zh: 立即前往医院评估孕晚期出血。

options.en: Wait for the next routine prenatal appointment if fetal movement is present.
options.zh: 若胎动存在，等待下一次常规产检。

options.en: Use a tampon to measure the bleeding and call back tomorrow.
options.zh: 使用卫生棉条测量出血量，明天再致电。

options.en: Restart hormonal contraception no sooner than 5 days after ulipristal; use abstinence or a barrier for 7 days after restarting.
options.zh: 服用醋酸乌利司他后至少等待 5 天再重启激素避孕；重启后禁欲或使用屏障避孕 7 天。

options.en: Restart the combined pill immediately with no backup method.
options.zh: 立即重启复方避孕药且无需备用避孕。

options.en: Avoid all contraception until the next menstrual period.
options.zh: 在下次月经前避免使用任何避孕方法。
